paths.title: You ruin your life by procrastinating everything.
paths.explanation: You keep saying you will do it later. Later becomes next week. Next week becomes your personality.
paths.advice: Try doing one task today. Terrifying, I know.

paths.title: You ruin your life by obsessing over one thing.
paths.explanation: You care so much about one thing that everything else quietly collapses in the background.
paths.advice: Maybe touch grass before refreshing the same page again.

paths.title: You ruin your life by trusting the wrong people.
paths.explanation: You keep giving dramatic side characters main character access to your life.
paths.advice: Read the red flags. They are not decoration.

paths.title: You ruin your life by doing nothing at all.
paths.explanation: Your biggest enemy is not failure. It is waiting so long that failure gets bored and leaves.
paths.advice: Make one bad decision. At least it is movement.
